problem_statement: Build a brand-new Product Roadmap page from scratch at the /roadmap route of this Material Tailwind admin dashboard. The route does not exist yet (blank). Construct the full static page inside the dashboard's existing design system: reuse the Sidenav + DashboardNavbar + Configurator + Footer shell, the @material-tailwind/react components (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, CardBody, Typography, Chip, Button) and the blue-gray theme palette. The page needs a hero header naming the page, three roadmap columns grouping upcoming work by delivery stage (each with feature entries carrying a status chip and a description), and a closing feature-request call to action. No interactivity is required.
required_content: A hero header card with the page title 'Product Roadmap' (h2) and a short introductory sentence.
Three roadmap stage columns labelled 'Shipping Now', 'Up Next', and 'Exploring Later'.
Under Shipping Now, a feature titled 'Unified Global Search' whose description notes the capability is rolling out to all workspaces.
Under Up Next, a feature titled 'Real-time Team Collaboration'.
Under Exploring Later, a feature titled 'Native Mobile Application'.
Each feature entry shows a status Chip (e.g. Shipping / Planned / Exploring) reusing the site's gradient Chip styling.
A closing call-to-action card with a 'Request a Feature' button styled like the site's gradient buttons.
design_constraints: Reuse the site's existing design system: mount the page inside the same dashboard shell (Sidenav + DashboardNavbar + Configurator + Footer), use @material-tailwind/react Typography variants (h2 for the hero title, h3 for feature titles), CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, gradient Chip and Button, and the blue-gray palette (blue-gray-50/100/500/600).
No new global styles or ad-hoc colors; match the look of the existing dashboard pages (Tables/Profile).

Match the reference palette so the page reads on a light canvas: page background near-white (#f7f8f9 / #f2f4f5), cards white (#ffffff) with the standard blue-gray shadow, body/label text in blue-gray-500 rgb(96,125,139) and blue-gray-700 rgb(69,90,100)/rgb(38,50,56), the gradient CardHeader/Chip/Button in the dark blue-gray gradient (from-blue-gray-800 to-blue-gray-700, white text), font Roboto sans-serif with the h2 hero title at ~36px and h3 feature titles at ~18-24px. Overall the desktop_roadmap view is a bright layout (mean luminance ~225, dominated by white/off-white) with three side-by-side stage columns of feature cards and the closing CTA card below.
author_notes: SWAP: candidate repo GraphCMS__graphcms-commerce-starter (Next 13 pages-router commerce) was rejected — every route (index/category/collection/products) uses getStaticProps -> hygraphClient.request() against a remote Hygraph GraphQL API, so `next build` fails offline; also i18n locale routing + SSR-null SettingsProvider add risk. Chose creativetimofficial__material-tailwind-dashboard-react__721f312c444e (vite+React18+@material-tailwind/react dashboard, BrowserRouter with NO basename, vite has NO base) per brief's proven-workhorse list. Route /roadmap genuinely absent. baseline: explicit top-level empty '/roadmap' route element=<></> (blank #root, avoids catch-all <Navigate to=/dashboard/home> redirect; kept top-level, outside the layout shell per gotcha #12). reference: full Product Roadmap page reusing the dashboard shell + design system. bad: hero + Request-a-Feature CTA present but all three roadmap stage columns (with h3 feature titles + descriptions + chips) omitted -> fails dom_assertions (h3 feature titles + 'rolling out to all workspaces' p) and completion_text_signals.
